messages:
Rae (PM): quick check — account-level billing list: default to org summary with compact sparkline + contributor chips, or full project rows? support still gets 'projects don't add up' tickets.
Indira (Design): leaning org-summary by default. show compact sparkline + up to 3 contributor chips (muted strokes). add a small 'View invoice mapping' link in header. expand reveals project rows.
Max (Frontend): agree. rendering many sparklines spikes CPU on low-end devices. plan: server-render org series; lazy-load project series on expand. chips show '+N' overflow.
Jo (Data): aggregation: use net spend (post-credits) for org sparkline so it aligns with invoice net. tokens column: show absolute + percent change (e.g., '7.2k (+1.9%)').
Sam (Billing): invoice mismatches mostly from credits/prorations/allocations. 'View invoice mapping' modal should list reasons and link to CSV. include a short example row to explain rounding.
Alex (Support): customers say 'my project totals don't match my bill' — modal bullets + FAQ blurb will help. also add a tiny reconciler popover on chip hover: project vs mapped invoice amount + 'View mapping' CTA.
Indira (Design): microcopy: header = 'Tokens billed' + tooltip 'Billing units for requests and responses.' accessibility: sparklines need aria-labels (min/max/last); tooltips keyboard-focusable; color contrast >= 4.5:1.
Max (Frontend): implementation plan: API returns org_aggregate + top_project_ids by default; /projects?expand=.. returns series; /invoice_mapping?ids=.. returns mappings (cache 24h). estimate: 4 FE days + 3 BE days.
Rae (PM): decisions: 1) default condensed org sparkline + up to 3 chips; 2) 'Expand projects' lazy-loads per-project sparklines; 3) add 'View invoice mapping' modal + chip popover; 4) token header: 'Tokens billed' + tooltip; 5) accessibility: aria labels + keyboard tooltips; 6) backend: mapping endpoint + 24h cache.
ui-bot: staging build passed: staging/billing-compact-2025-01-10 :white_check_mark:
Rae (PM): thanks team — Indira will update mocks; Max/Sam to file tickets; Support will draft FAQ. Sync next Wednesday.
